title: Bar Tzitai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Yevamot 21b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.21b.4), Abaye tells Rava, “For example, the daughter-in-law of the house of Bar Tzitai.” In [Moed Katan 4b](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.4b.4), Rav Yehudah permits the members of the house of Bar Tzitai to make water basins around their vines. [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Moed_Katan.4b.4.1) explains Tzitai as a place-name, but Hyman observes that [Yevamot 21b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.21b.4) suggests a family name.

notes.text: Rashi explains the basins as pits beneath vines and olive trees, into which water is placed.
